visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed interactive showcase of images/videos that play one after another; exterior variant with a glass panel listing all item titles (expandable details, play/pause ring), interior variant dark with intro video, headline + details and a control bar (circle pagination, sound, play/pause)
contentPattern: One row per item: cell 1 = media (desktop, mobile[, tablet] images, or poster images + desktop/mobile video links), cell 2 = h3 title + description paragraphs. With option intro the first row is the intro media with an h2 intro title.
